screen.academy.precision_operation.no_se: Select a node to inspect its typed ports and parameter.
Capability Support
Keeps entities supporting the selected mental-control capability.
Under Mental Control
Keeps entities in the caster's roster or with an active mental-control lease.
Alive Filter
Keeps entities that are alive and not removed.
Allies
Keeps allies according to teams and friendly-fire protection.
Caster
Returns the player executing this program.
Entity Current Target
Returns the supplied entity's effective current target.
Direction Between
Outputs the normalized direction from position A to position B.
Distance Filter
Keeps entities within the selected distance of the caster.
Branch: Distance
Takes the true branch when the subject is within the selected distance of the caster.
End Mental Intrusion
Ends the caster's active Mental Intrusion session.
Enemies
Keeps non-allied entities other than the caster.
Entity Position
Reads an entity's current location and outputs a fixed-position destination.
Entity To Set
Wraps one entity as an entity set for filters and actions.
Branch: Entity Type
Takes the true branch when the subject matches the selected broad entity type.
Exclude Entity
Removes one specified entity from a set.
Farthest Entity
Selects the entity farthest from the caster.
Guard Mode
Keeps controlled subjects near an entity or place and attacks threats to the target, caster, or caster allies.
Has Target
Keeps entities that currently have an effective target.
Health At Most
Keeps entities at or below the selected health percentage.
Health At Least
Keeps entities at or above the selected health percentage.
Branch: Health Ratio
Takes the true branch when the subject's health ratio is at or below the threshold.
Highest Health
Selects the entity with the highest health percentage.
Hostile To Entity
Keeps entities judged hostile to the supplied entity.
Impression Manipulation
Makes the selected subjects treat the caster as an ally.
Intersect Sets
Keeps entities present in both input sets.
Observation Target
Returns the current Mental Intrusion observation target.
Entity Last Attacker
Returns the living entity that most recently hurt the subject.
Damaged By Entity
Keeps entities most recently damaged by the supplied attacker.
Limit Count
Keeps at most the selected number of entities in stable order.
Server Look Target
Returns the living entity under the server-verified crosshair up to 64 blocks away.
Lowest Health
Selects the entity with the lowest health percentage.
Mental Stupor
Applies Mental Stupor to the selected subjects.
Nearby Entities
Collects every entity in range of the caster, excluding the caster.
Nearby Living Entities
Collects living entities within the selected range of the caster.
Nearby Dropped Items
Collects dropped-item entities in range of the caster.
Nearby Projectiles
Collects projectile entities in range of the caster.
Nearest Entity
Selects the entity nearest to the caster.
On Cast
Starts the program when the ability is cast.
Path To Target
Orders supported subjects to path toward the supplied target. The caster may be a subject; moving, turning, attacking, or using an item interrupts the caster's own effect.
Perception Mask
Prevents the observers from perceiving the hidden entity.
Last Attacked Target
Returns the last living entity attacked by the caster.
Position Offset
Offsets the origin along the supplied direction and outputs a new fixed-position destination.
Random Entity
Selects one random entity from a set on the server.
Release Control
Releases the selected subjects from the intervention roster and Precision Operation control, suppressing automatic recall until they leave recall range.
Controlled Roster
Returns the caster's currently controlled entities.
Sight Position
Server-raycasts up to 64 blocks from the observer; entity hits stay dynamic while block hits use the outside face position.
Sort By Distance
Sorts a set by distance from the caster.
Start Mental Intrusion
Starts Mental Intrusion on the supplied target.
Branch: Has Status Effect
Takes the true branch when the subject currently has at least one status effect.
Subtract Sets
Removes every entity in the right set from the left set.
Target Misidentification
Forces the subjects to identify the supplied entity as their target.
Targeting Entity
Keeps entities whose effective target is the supplied entity.
Entity Type
Keeps entities matching the selected broad entity type.
Union Sets
Combines two sets and removes duplicate entities.
Look At Target
Orders supported subjects to look at the supplied target. The caster may be a subject; moving, turning, attacking, or using an item interrupts the caster's own effect.
Visible To Observer
Keeps entities visible to the supplied observer using server line of sight.
Flow entry (leave open on first action)
Flow exit (leave open on last action)

skill.academy.arc_generate.proficiency.3: The arc chains to up to 2 enemies within 4 blocks, dealing 50% and 30% damage.
skill.academy.area_teleport_select.desc: Press Y to mark two source corners, Alt+Y to set the destination, and Shift+Y to start. Blocks, block entities, and non-player entities move transactionally while entity offsets, facing, and vehicle relationships are preserved. The base limit is 32 blocks per axis.
skill.academy.area_teleport_select.profi: Corner and destination-anchor ray range increases from 80 to 96 blocks, and activation cost -10%.
Per-axis limit increases from 32 to 36 blocks; Shift+Alt+Y cycles Y-axis rotation; moved entities receive 2 seconds of fall protection.
Per-axis limit increases from 36 to 40 blocks; unlocks X/Z mirroring and Swap mode toggled with Ctrl+Alt+Y.
skill.academy.atmosphere_blast_gun.desc: Release a wide air blast or charge a focused cannon; charge time is verified by the server.
skill.academy.atmosphere_blast_gun.profi: Wide-mode length increases from 8 to 10 blocks and focused-mode range +25%.
A 4-block cone behind the first focused hit deals 40% main damage and continues the knockback.
skill.academy.atmosphere_shield.desc: Maintain a compressed-air film that strengthens attacks and knockback.
skill.academy.atmosphere_shield.proficie: Stopped projectiles lose momentum after hovering for 20 ticks, then drop or dissipate.
Full-negation threshold rises from 4 to 6 damage; other reduction gains 10 percentage points, capped at 50%.
skill.academy.atmospheric_dominion.desc: Command a broad atmosphere that protects allies, hinders enemies, and amplifies air skills.
skill.academy.atmospheric_dominion.profi: Radius rises from 22 to 26 blocks and duration from 400 to 480 ticks.
Allies receive half-strength base Breathing Film, Air Cushion, and Tailwind Field effects without their occupations or final rewards. (Not yet implemented)
skill.academy.auto_cruise_beam_cannon.de: Reserve CP to scan a 16-block radius and automatically fire delayed electron beams at hostile targets.
skill.academy.auto_cruise_beam_cannon.pr: Scan radius increases from 16 to 20 blocks and formation delay -25%.
Prioritizes radiation-marked or lowest-health targets; after 3 consecutive hits, the fourth shot splits to another target for 50% ordinary damage.
skill.academy.ball_lightning.desc: Create a long-lived autonomous lightning orb with synchronized arc and core effects; it hunts nearby targets and detonates through the skill damage pipeline.
skill.academy.ball_lightning.proficiency: Search range and movement speed +20%; lifetime is unchanged.
On expiry or collision, splits into 2 small spheres lasting 5 seconds and dealing 30% damage each.
skill.academy.bioelectric_operation.desc: Reserve computing power to drive your body electrically, improving movement, attacks, mining, jumping, and fall control.
skill.academy.bioelectric_operation.prof: Non-damage attribute bonuses +20%; attack damage is unchanged.
Below 30% health, overload grants +15% movement and attack speed for +5 CP/s; only overload ends if CP is insufficient.
skill.academy.black_wing.desc: Upgrade Storm Wing into a two-wing vector flight form; normal attacks sweep a 32-block fan for true-health damage.
skill.academy.black_wing.proficiency.200: Sweep range rises from 32 to 36 blocks and cone angle +10°.
skill.academy.black_wing.proficiency.300: Sweeps mark for 5 seconds; the next hit pulls inward, adds 30% ordinary damage, and consumes the mark.
skill.academy.bloodflow_reverse.desc: Reverse a nearby target's blood flow, dealing biological damage and applying movement, attack, and mining penalties.
skill.academy.bloodflow_reverse.proficie: Lock range +4 blocks and debuff duration +25%.
Healing received is reduced for 10 seconds by 50%, or 25% for bosses and players.
skill.academy.brain_domain_development.d: Increase maximum CP by 5 per proficiency tier and ability level.
skill.academy.breathing_film.desc: Maintain a thin layer of air that prevents oxygen loss underwater.
skill.academy.breathing_film.proficiency: Shares with teammates within 4 blocks for a flat additional 5 CP occupation while any ally is covered.
Also blocks suffocation-type environments, smoke, and harmful air sources defined by server tags.
skill.academy.cloudroom.desc: Reserve 30 CP to reveal the recent movement of living entities within sixteen blocks using synchronized smoke trails.
skill.academy.cloudroom.proficiency.2000: Detection radius increases from 16 to 24 blocks and trail retention +50%.
skill.academy.cloudroom.proficiency.3000: Shows invisible creatures and discontinuities before and after teleportation, synchronizing only outlines without removing invisibility.
skill.academy.command_positioning.desc: Order compatible roster members to move to the outside face of the block under the crosshair, or continuously follow the entity under it, up to 64 blocks away.
skill.academy.command_positioning.profic: Path reservation per target falls from 10 to 9 CP.
Command range increases from 64 to 80 blocks; path recalculation interval -25%. (Not yet implemented)
Ground commands arrange roster members in a size-aware ring instead of one block; bosses retain their movement contract.
skill.academy.complete_consciousness_ana: Increase the CP iterated by each SP by 10% per proficiency tier.
skill.academy.crossing_the_abyss.desc: Reserve 50 CP so your damage pressures true health, ratchets down the target's healing ceiling, and defeats targets that repeatedly survive lethal damage.
skill.academy.crossing_the_abyss.profici: Healing-cap reduction duration +25%; execution still requires three survivals.
Your executions or kills spread a 25% healing reduction for 5 seconds to enemies within 6 blocks.
skill.academy.current_recharge.desc: Hold the key to continuously charge the block, creature, and held or worn equipment in your sights. Computing power is consumed each tick only while a target is found.
skill.academy.current_recharge.proficien: Range increases from 5 to 8 blocks and supports the target's hand, armor, and personal energy containers.
Overflow charges up to 4 nearby teammates within 3 blocks without exceeding the original input. (Not yet implemented)
skill.academy.current_symbiosis.desc: Continuously recharge the energy storage of your held and worn equipment.
skill.academy.current_symbiosis.proficie: Also charges energy items in the hotbar; charge throughput +50%. (Not yet implemented)
With a fully equipped current-symbiosis set, stored overcharge reduces the next electrical cast cost by 20%, once per 5 seconds.
skill.academy.darkmatter_creation.desc: Summon up to eight owned beetles; look at one and cast again to dismiss it.
skill.academy.darkmatter_creation.profic: Summon cost and maintenance per beetle -10%.
Beetle target range and chase speed +20%; count cap is unchanged. Attack-interval efficiency +20%. (Not yet implemented)
When at least 3 beetles attack the same target, encirclement increases beetle damage to it by 25%, without affecting other skills.
skill.academy.darkmatter_cut.desc: Release a dark-matter slash that damages hostile targets in an eight-block forward cone.
skill.academy.darkmatter_cut.proficiency: Distance and cone angle +20% in both normal and Six Wings forms.
After 8 ticks, a delayed rift follows the same path for 50% ordinary damage, hitting each target at most once.
skill.academy.darkmatter_disassemble.des: Disassemble a server-selected target or permitted block within 32 blocks.
skill.academy.darkmatter_disassemble.pro: Range increases from 32 to 40 blocks; Six Wings radius gains another 1 block.
Ignores 20% armor on the central entity, or 10% against players; secondary area targets receive no penetration.
skill.academy.darkmatter_radiation.desc: Hold to irradiate hostile targets in the forward hemisphere within 32 blocks.
skill.academy.darkmatter_radiation.profi: Hemisphere reach increases from 32 to 36 blocks and edge damage no longer falls off.
After 20 effective exposure ticks, a 3-block pulse deals 400% of one exposure hit, once per target every 20 ticks.
skill.academy.darkmatter_repair.desc: Toggle continuous self-repair that consumes computing power only while restoring health.
skill.academy.darkmatter_repair.proficie: Overhealing at full health becomes absorption up to 8 points and is charged by the actual converted amount.
skill.academy.darkmatter_shaping.desc: Create dark matter with an empty hand, or repair and toggle dark-matter reinforcement on the held item.
skill.academy.darkmatter_shaping.profici: Base cost while casting with an item falls from 50 to 25 CP; the item is still repaired to full immediately.
While holding an enhanced item below 25% durability, may auto-repair once per second and charge by actual repair; configurable in skill settings.
skill.academy.darkmatter_six_wings.desc: Reserve computing power to gain flight and amplify Dark Matter Cut and Disassemble.
skill.academy.darkmatter_six_wings.profi: Flight speed +15%, and Six Wings Cut/Disassemble range gains another 10%.
While active, Dark Matter active-skill cast/continuous costs fall another 10%, capped at 25% total with skill discounts; owned beetles gain aerial pursuit.
skill.academy.defensive_teleport.desc: Hold to select a 5×5×5 box at the crosshair, then release to send hostile targets and projectiles to the selected Location Teleport mark.
skill.academy.defensive_teleport.profici: Projectiles lose their original target and retain 50% speed at destination; creatures receive 3 seconds of Slowness.
skill.academy.dir_strike.desc: Drive a circular 12-block kinetic shock through the ground, damaging hostile targets and lifting nearby terrain as a render-only wave.
skill.academy.dir_strike.proficiency.200: Effective radius rises from 12 to 14 blocks.
skill.academy.dir_strike.proficiency.300: Targets within 4 blocks are pressed down and take a second 40% hit after 6 ticks without extra block damage.
skill.academy.disarm.desc: Scan 16 blocks along the crosshair, teleport an item out of the first hittable living target, and deal skill damage.
skill.academy.disarm.proficiency.2000: Range increases from 16 to 20 blocks and both hands may be processed; the second item costs another 100% base cost.
skill.academy.disarm.proficiency.3000: Disarmed items enter a 5-second spatial cache and cannot be reclaimed; afterward they drop at the target's original position and cannot be kept by the caster.
skill.academy.disintegrate.desc: Fire a special particle beam for 20% of maximum health. A kill scatters up to three beams; secondary kills scatter once more without further chaining.
skill.academy.disintegrate.proficiency.2: Range +20%, and first-kill scatter limit increases from 3 to 4.
skill.academy.disintegrate.proficiency.3: Surviving targets are Disintegrated for 5 seconds, reducing effective armor by 25%, or 12.5% for players; chain depth is unchanged.
skill.academy.electrical_contact.desc: Reserve 15 CP to shock nearby enemies periodically and return an attributed electrical shock to hostile melee attackers.
skill.academy.electrical_contact.profici: Trigger radius increases from 2 to 3 blocks and interval falls from 40 to 30 ticks.
Retaliation marks the attacker for 4 seconds; the next electrical hit chains 50% damage to one enemy within 4 blocks.
skill.academy.electromagnetic_shield.des: Absorb incoming damage into an electromagnetic barrier that cools by consuming CP.
skill.academy.electromagnetic_shield.pro: Shield capacity +25% and cooling rate increases from 10 to 15 per tick.
A full overload emits a 4-block pulse applying Slowness II and Weakness I for 2 seconds, with a 10-second cooldown.
skill.academy.endurance_training.desc: Increase endurance by 50 per proficiency tier.
skill.academy.flashing.desc: Press H to enable the skill, then press W/A/S/D to flash 8 blocks in that movement direction; press H again to disable it.
skill.academy.flashing.proficiency.2000: Distance increases from 8 to 10 blocks and the client directional-input interval falls from 6 to 4 ticks; the server minimum remains 2 ticks.
skill.academy.flashing.proficiency.3000: Queues up to 3 consecutive W/A/S/D inputs before the previous flash finishes; every flash is independently validated and charged.
skill.academy.flesh_ripping.desc: Hold Alt+Right Mouse to lock a living target within 64 blocks, then release to deal 12 plus 5% maximum-health spatial damage.
The lock persists for 10 ticks after briefly losing sight.
Applies Spatial Laceration for 5 seconds, reducing effective armor by 20% and received healing by 25%; values are halved for players.
skill.academy.flight.desc: Maintain an air current that grants controlled creative-style flight.
skill.academy.flight.proficiency.2000: Normal and high-speed flight caps +15%, with unchanged acceleration.
skill.academy.flight.proficiency.3000: Automatically air-brakes before frontal block collisions and cancels that collision damage once every 5 seconds.
skill.academy.flow_sense.desc: Sense moving entities and projectiles through line of sight and read their motion.
skill.academy.flow_sense.proficiency.200: Refresh interval falls from 10 to 5 ticks and the sync limit rises from 64 to 96 targets.
skill.academy.flow_sense.proficiency.300: Shows one second of predicted projectile motion and warns of impacts expected within 10 ticks.
skill.academy.impression_manipulation.de: Suppress natural aggression in compatible controlled targets, allowing only self-defense, defense of their controller, and target misidentification while reserving CP.
skill.academy.impression_manipulation.pr: Default reservation per target falls from 10 to 9 CP.
Default reservation per target reaches 8 CP; guard-target switching responds 50% faster. (Not yet implemented)
Roster members attacking the same authorized target gain 10% attack and movement speed, fading 3 seconds after disengaging; damage is unchanged.
skill.academy.iron_sand_arsenal.desc: Reserve 50 CP to orbit iron sand, repel nearby hostiles, and sweep a 120-degree forward sector when swinging your main hand.
skill.academy.iron_sand_arsenal.proficie: Whip hits mark targets for 4 seconds; close defense consumes the mark for +50% whip damage and pulls frontal targets.
skill.academy.jet_strike.desc: Dash toward a safe point eight blocks ahead and damage creatures around the destination.
skill.academy.jet_strike.proficiency.200: Maximum dash distance increases from 8 to 10 blocks and impact radius +20%.
skill.academy.jet_strike.proficiency.300: Leaves a 10-tick particle wake; first contact deals 40% ordinary impact damage once per target.
skill.academy.kinetic_energy_applied.des: Reserve computing power to strengthen movement and attacks. Left-click impacts entities or blocks, while an air swing releases the impact forward. Cycle strength from 1 to 6 and toggle block destruction separately.
skill.academy.kinetic_energy_applied.pro: Impact-wave radius +15% at every level; block-processing radius is unchanged.
A 30% aftershock follows direct impacts after 6 ticks, once per target per second.
skill.academy.laminar_cutter.desc: Fire a precise laminar blade that cuts targets and permitted soft blocks.
skill.academy.laminar_cutter.proficiency: Blade length +20% and removable-block hardness rises one tier, still subject to protection checks.
Hits reduce effective armor for 5 seconds by 20%, or 10% against players.
skill.academy.light_shield.desc: Hold to project a visible shield and gain Resistance II while periodic pulses repel and damage nearby hostile mobs.
skill.academy.light_shield.proficiency.2: Radius increases from 3.5 to 4.5 blocks and knockback +20%.
skill.academy.light_shield.proficiency.3: Destroys hostile projectiles in range and restores 2 CP each, up to 10 CP/s; indestructible projectiles are only slowed.
skill.academy.lightning_nova.desc: Release a visible expanding electrical ring that damages targets as the wavefront crosses them.
skill.academy.lightning_nova.proficiency: After reaching maximum radius, an inward echo deals 50% damage; each target can be hit once by each wave.
skill.academy.lightning_storm.desc: Call twenty-one visual lightning strikes around the server-raycast target, with each pulse attributed to the skill and scaled by ability damage.
skill.academy.lightning_storm.proficienc: Storm radius increases from 8 to 10 blocks and target range +20%.
Every third pulse prefers an enemy not yet struck by the storm.
skill.academy.location_teleport.desc: Save up to 32 named locations and teleport safely between dimensions.
skill.academy.location_teleport.proficie: Saved-location limit increases from 32 to 48; grouping by dimension is supported. (Not yet implemented)
Within 5 seconds, cast the same saved-location entry again in the Location Teleport screen to return once for 50% of the first actual cost.
skill.academy.magnet_manipulation.desc: Hold while aiming at an iron-bearing block or entity to pull yourself toward it. Hold Shift to pull the target in front of you.
skill.academy.magnet_manipulation.profic: Releasing throws the target; collision damage scales with speed up to 12, excluding bosses. (Not yet implemented)
skill.academy.magnetic_weapon.desc: Toggle while holding a sword to reserve 40 CP; the floating blade attacks threats within 16 blocks every 10 ticks and returns.
skill.academy.magnetic_weapon.proficienc: Target range increases from 16 to 20 blocks and attack interval falls from 10 to 8 ticks.
Every 20 ticks, intercepts one frontal hostile projectile and counters its source.
skill.academy.mental_intervention.desc: Add the living entity in sight, including an eligible player, to the controlled roster; use it again to release that target.
skill.academy.mental_intervention.profic: Cast cost -10%, and selection range increases from 16 to 20 blocks.
Selection range increases from 20 to 24 blocks.
Adding a non-player may also add up to 2 compatible same-type creatures within 4 blocks, each independently charged and protection-checked.
skill.academy.mental_intrusion.desc: Continuously observe the living entity in sight without moving or controlling it while reserving CP.
skill.academy.mental_intrusion.proficien: Maximum session distance increases from 96 to 128 blocks and persists beyond normal selection range.
The view shows health, armor, major effects, and held items; maximum player observation duration +50%, still limited by cooldown.
skill.academy.mental_stupor.desc: Toggle a lasting suppression of movement and actions for compatible controlled targets while reserving CP.
Default reservation per target falls from 10 to 9 CP.
Default reservation per target reaches 8 CP; boss and player cost multipliers are unchanged.
After 3 seconds, non-player targets enter deep stupor and cannot jump, sprint, or continuously use items.
skill.academy.mental_takeover.desc: While intruding into a rostered target, continuously control its movement, view, and attacks; player targets may still break free.
skill.academy.mental_takeover.proficienc: Session reservation falls from 100 to 90 CP.
Target struggle progress builds 25% slower; true damage still interrupts immediately under the original rule.
Unlocks server-validated offhand use and hotbar switching, at most once per second; containers, item dropping, and inventory editing remain blocked.
skill.academy.mine_detect.desc: Reserve CP to reveal nearby ore blocks in already loaded chunks.
skill.academy.mine_detect.proficiency.20: Detection radius increases from 64 to 80 blocks and scan budget +50%.
skill.academy.mine_detect.proficiency.30: Loaded ore blocks are grouped into veins and shown with size, distance, and highest-value ore. (Not yet implemented)
skill.academy.mining_beam.desc: Hold to bore through breakable blocks and damage entities along a 48-block beam.
skill.academy.mining_beam.proficiency.20: Range increases from 48 to 56 blocks and breaking radius +20%.
skill.academy.mining_beam.proficiency.30: Ores with smelting recipes drop smelted products and normal experience; this effect is controlled by the server proficiency policy.
skill.academy.multiple_brain_domain_segm: Increase every skill's stack limit by the current proficiency tier.
skill.academy.parallel_thought_computati: Increase CP iteration speed by 5% per proficiency tier.
skill.academy.particle_wave_cannon.desc: Hold to charge a wide 85-block beam that continuously destroys blocks and damages marked targets.
skill.academy.particle_wave_cannon.profi: Maximum range increases from 85 to 96 blocks and beam width +15%.
Radiation-marked targets remain irradiated for 3 seconds after leaving, taking 20% ordinary pulse damage each second without refreshing the mark.
skill.academy.physical_training.desc: Increase muscle strength and dexterity by 25 per proficiency tier.
skill.academy.piercing_teleportation.des: Hold Alt+R to preview the nearest safe position beyond the first blocking block within 40 blocks, or the 40-block point if unobstructed. Scrolling switches to free adjustment from the displayed position, allowing any safe destination within 64 blocks, including one before a wall; release to teleport.
skill.academy.piercing_teleportation.pro: Base range is now 64 blocks; no additional effect is configured for this tier. (Not yet implemented)
Retains 50% horizontal momentum on arrival and prevents wall-collision damage from it for 10 ticks.
skill.academy.plasma_generation.desc: Gather a visible plasma core above the caster, then launch a server-targeted destructive blast after at least three seconds of charging.
skill.academy.plasma_generation.proficie: Minimum charge falls from 3 to 2.4 seconds and explosion radius +10%.
Leaves a 5-second plasma zone dealing 8% ordinary explosion damage each second, without executions or true damage.
skill.academy.platinum_wing.desc: Ascend beyond White Wing; normal attacks retain the true-health fan strike, while sneaking attacks execute a crosshair target up to 128 blocks away.
Execution preparation and cooldown -20%; range is unchanged.
Unexecutable bosses instead take capped ordinary skill damage equal to 15% maximum health.
skill.academy.pneumatic_grasp.desc: Hold to pull or push items, experience, projectiles, and hostile mobs; maximum proficiency can affect other airborne living targets.
skill.academy.pneumatic_grasp.proficienc: Heavy-target response +20%; controlled projectiles retain their original speed cap.
Can control grounded non-boss mobs at 50% force for 5 CP every 5 ticks.
skill.academy.precision_operation.desc: Press \ to open the Precision Operation editor and configure up to 10 program slots; press Alt+1..0 to run the corresponding slot.
skill.academy.precision_operation.profic: All per-target continuous reservations inside programs -10%.
Across 2 or more active slots, duplicate perception/path nodes for a shared target are charged once to the earliest-started slot.
Unlocks one bounded acyclic conditional branch by health ratio, distance, target type, or status effect; node and execution budgets are unchanged.
skill.academy.pressure_lock.desc: Hold a visible target in place with server-authoritative pressure control.
Maximum duration rises from 200 to 240 ticks and tolerates 10 ticks without line of sight.
Stored attempted movement becomes a directed push of at most 1.5 blocks per second when the lock ends.
skill.academy.quick_location_teleport.de: Send the entity under your crosshair, or yourself, to the selected saved location.
skill.academy.quick_location_teleport.pr: Moves the target's root vehicle and passenger hierarchy as one unit; per-member safety validation and rejecting the entire unpaid operation on failure are pending. (Not yet implemented)
skill.academy.radiation_intensify.desc: Electron-beam hits mark targets for ten seconds; later beam hits deal 50% more damage.
skill.academy.radiation_intensify.profic: Mark duration increases from 10 to 12 seconds.
Subsequent beam damage bonus increases from 50% to 60%, affecting only ordinary damage.
When a marked target dies, copies its remaining duration to up to 3 enemies within 5 blocks without dealing damage.
skill.academy.railgun.desc: Charge and fire a destructive electromagnetic shot using a coin, iron ingot, iron block, anvil, or nearby thrown coin.
skill.academy.railgun.proficiency.1000: Final cast cost -10%, and charging cost -10%.
skill.academy.railgun.proficiency.2000: Range +20%; the shot penetrates the first entity and deals 60% damage to the next.
skill.academy.railgun.proficiency.3000: Impact creates a 4-block non-terrain shockwave dealing 25% primary damage and knockback.
skill.academy.reflection_filter.desc: Configure which status effects may pass through Vector Reflection by mode, whitelist, and blacklist.
skill.academy.reflection_filter.proficie: Dynamic CP cost for filtered harmful effects -15%.
Returns half the remaining duration at the original amplifier to a valid applier, once every 5 seconds per applier.
The first harmful effect every 10 seconds is fully reflected at no extra cost; boss sources are only intercepted.
skill.academy.scatter_bomb.desc: Charge and release seven delayed electron beams, each dealing base damage plus one percent of the target's maximum health.
skill.academy.scatter_bomb.proficiency.2: Charge time for the same beam count -20%, and maximum beam count increases from 7 to 8.
skill.academy.scatter_bomb.proficiency.3: Before forming, a missed beam may redirect once toward the nearest radiation-marked target within 8 blocks.
skill.academy.self_teleport.desc: Hold R and scroll to set a distance up to 64 blocks (40 by default), then release to teleport to a collision-safe position before the first blocking block or nearer.
Base range is now 64 blocks; no additional effect is configured for this tier. (Not yet implemented)
Within 3 seconds of arrival, stay crouched and fully hold then release R again to return for 50% of the first actual cost; unsafe origins reject the return.
skill.academy.sensory_distortion.desc: While observing a target, hide yourself from its sight, targeting, perception memories and direct interactions while reserving CP.
skill.academy.sensory_distortion.profici: Also suppresses ordinary footsteps, game-event vibrations, and non-attack particles; damage and block interaction still reveal the caster.
Leaving a target's sight creates a 3-second false afterimage for natural targeting; explicit attack targets are not misled.
skill.academy.shackle.desc: Hold Ctrl to preview the first hittable living target within 32 blocks, then shackle it for 5 seconds and deal skill damage.
skill.academy.shackle.proficiency.2000: Imprisonment for non-player targets increases from 8 to 10 seconds; players remain at 8 seconds.
skill.academy.shackle.proficiency.3000: A target forcibly moved over 2 blocks while shackled returns to its anchor and takes 40% secondary damage, once per imprisonment.
skill.academy.single_high_speed_electron: Fire a delayed electron beam that deals base damage plus one percent of the target's maximum health.
The beam continues through the first creature once, dealing 60% ordinary damage to the second target; maximum-health damage does not penetrate.
skill.academy.space_folding_theorem.desc: Increase compatible Teleport skill damage by 25%.
skill.academy.space_folding_theorem.prof: Compatible spatial damage multiplier increases from 1.25 to 1.30.
The multiplier reaches 1.35, and self-movement skill distance +10%.
The multiplier reaches 1.40; spatial-damage kills refund 20% of that attack's actual cost, at most once every 3 seconds.
skill.academy.spacial_excision.desc: Consume available CP to charge an expanding spatial excision that deals attributed damage and removes only blocks allowed by server protection rules.
skill.academy.spacial_excision.proficien: CP required for the same radius -10%.
Maximum radius +20%, and damage pulse interval falls from 10 to 8 ticks.
Creates boundary-shell pulses at 10/20/30/40 ticks after ending; each deals 25% of the main damage as ordinary damage to creatures inside the shell.
skill.academy.spatial_synergy.desc: While enabled, Self Teleport, Penetrate Teleport, and Location Teleport carry same-team players within 4 blocks.
skill.academy.spatial_synergy.proficienc: Default maintenance reservation falls from 20 to 18 CP.
Carry radius increases from 4 to 6 blocks.
Also carries nearby allied or tamed non-player living entities, excluding passengers; each additional entity adds 10 CP temporary cost.
skill.academy.storm_wing.desc: Reserve 20 CP to sustain vector flight; steer with movement keys and hold Space for the high-speed boost.
skill.academy.storm_wing.proficiency.200: Steering response and high-speed thrust cap +15%.
skill.academy.storm_wing.proficiency.300: High-speed flight leaves a 2-second wake that propels allies and slows hostile projectiles by 40%.
skill.academy.tailwind_field.desc: Maintain a personal current that accelerates allies and resists hostile movement.
skill.academy.tailwind_field.proficiency: Allied projectiles gain 20% speed; opposing hostile projectiles are deflected without changing ownership.
skill.academy.target_misidentification.d: Permanently force every compatible controlled mob to mistake the selected living entity for an enemy; select it again to release the effect.
skill.academy.target_misidentification.p: False-target range increases from 64 to 80 blocks; batch application delay is halved. (Not yet implemented)
When the false target dies, roster members retarget the nearest valid enemy within 8 blocks once; otherwise the effect ends.
skill.academy.threatening_teleport.desc: Hold Alt+Left Mouse, or select the skill in the right HUD and hold C, to preview a living target within 64 blocks; release to teleport one main-hand item into it and deal damage. Without a lock, the item drops 16 blocks forward; a killing hit returns it among the target's death drops, while a surviving target consumes it.
skill.academy.threatening_teleport.profi: Living-target lock range is now 64 blocks; no additional effect is configured for this tier. (Not yet implemented)
Generated item entities return to the caster's inventory if uncollected for 3 seconds; if full, they drop at the caster's feet.
skill.academy.thunder_lance.desc: Fire four lightning arcs from your hand, damaging targets along a 32-block path.
Range increases from 32 to 40 blocks and spear width +20%.
Targets hit by at least 2 arcs chain 40% damage to the nearest enemy within 6 blocks.
skill.academy.thunderclap.desc: Call visual lightning onto a server-selected target and damage nearby creatures based on maximum health.
skill.academy.thunderclap.proficiency.20: Target range increases from 64 to 80 blocks and blast radius from 5 to 6 blocks.
skill.academy.thunderclap.proficiency.30: Applies Slowness IV and Weakness II for 3 seconds, halved against bosses and players.
skill.academy.vacuum_domain.desc: Create a temporary vacuum that suffocates and damages hostile creatures.
Placement range rises from 16 to 20 blocks and radius from 12 to 14 blocks.
Pulls enemies inward, extinguishes fire, and removes ordinary clouds without increasing percentage damage.
skill.academy.vector_accel.desc: Charge a server-authorized vector dash; longer charging increases speed and the trajectory preview shows the collision path.
skill.academy.vector_accel.proficiency.2: Charge time needed for the same speed -25%.
skill.academy.vector_accel.proficiency.3: The first enemy collision deals 6 scaled skill damage, knocks it forward, and preserves 50% dash speed.
skill.academy.vector_blast.desc: Project a 64-block vector blast that damages targets along its path. Crossing the Abyss adds an area of true damage ahead.
skill.academy.vector_blast.proficiency.2: Range rises from 64 to 72 blocks and impact width +20%.
skill.academy.vector_blast.proficiency.3: Creates a 3-block endpoint burst for 40% ordinary main damage without copying special damage.
skill.academy.vector_deviation.desc: Reserve 75 CP to create a spherical vector field that slows nearby entities and projectiles without accelerating targets outside its radius.
skill.academy.vector_deviation.proficien: Negated damage occupies CP at ×1 of processed damage.
Negated damage occupies CP at ×0.5 of processed damage.
Iteration interval decreases from 10 to 5 ticks; deflectable damage below 1% of maximum CP has no dynamic cost. Tier damage-cost multipliers are ×2 / ×1 / ×0.5 / ×0.5.
skill.academy.vector_reflection.desc: Maintain a bounded vector field that absorbs eligible incoming damage, reverses projectiles, and returns amplified damage to hostile attackers.
skill.academy.vector_reflection.proficie: Reflected damage occupies CP at ×1 of processed damage.
Reflected damage occupies CP at ×0.5 of processed damage.
Iteration interval decreases from 10 to 5 ticks; reflectable damage below 1% of maximum CP has no dynamic cost. Tier damage-cost multipliers are ×2 / ×1 / ×0.5 / ×0.5.
skill.academy.vortex_pull.desc: Create a rising vortex that draws entities, items, and projectiles into an airborne core.
skill.academy.vortex_pull.proficiency.30: Stores up to 16 unowned or hostile projectiles and releases them along your view at 75% speed when the vortex ends.
skill.academy.white_wing.desc: Upgrade Black Wing into its white form while retaining vector flight and the 32-block true-health fan attack.
skill.academy.white_wing.proficiency.200: Deflects one frontal hostile projectile within 6 blocks every 20 ticks without reflecting damage.
skill.academy.white_wing.proficiency.300: Each valid sweep target restores 3 CP, capped at 15 CP per sweep; true-health damage is unchanged.
skill.academy.wind_corridor.desc: Open a long-lived air corridor that transports allies, items, and projectiles.
Length increases from 24 to 30 blocks and duration from 160 to 220 ticks.
Recasting redirects the active corridor and refreshes half its duration for half base cost.
